excerpt.zh:
我们对纳米机器人的研究完成了。尽管它们的潜力仍不完全明确，但是模拟计算已经得到了很正面的预测。其能力在创造特化的大型形体以及物质变形方面具有不可估量的价值。

估算预测这个过程需要时间、材料和能量，需要大量的结构调整来支持。

可行性：具有前景；变革性。
excerpt.en:
Our research on nanites has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

texts.en:
Our research on nanites has concluded. The full extent of their potential remains unclear, but simulations have returned optimistic projections. Their capabilities could prove invaluable in creating specialized megaforms and matter transmutation.

Estimations indicate that the process requires time, materials, and energy to operate in addition to significant structural changes.

Viability: promising; transformative.
